title: Automatic Anthropometric System Development Using Machine Learning
author: Long The Nguyen
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Extract features and build 3D model
steps.instruction: ABSTRACT The contactless automatic anthropometric system is proposed for the reconstruction of the 3D-model of the human body using the conventional smartphone. Our approach involves three main steps. The first step is the extraction of 12 anthropological features. Then we determine the most important features. Finally, we employ these features to build the 3D model of the human body and classify them according to gender and the commonly used sizes.

substeps.instruction: Extract 12 anthropological features using the conventional smartphone
Build the 3D model of the human body using these features
Classify the model according to gender and the commonly used sizes
